items.title_orig: Feels like im cheating... but i love it
items.article_text:
I been obsessed with les pauls since I was a kid... in the last 5 years I have really gotten into playing electric, and collecting various Les Pauls... up to 8 at one point.. had an um.. Paul Wall, if you will lol.... yes I have tried others, (fender strat, US PRS single cut, etc) but couldn't really get connected with them. Nor play them as well as I play a les paul.. 
 I have CMT, a degenerative nerve disease that causes severe muscle wasting in the hands and feet. I can't button a shirt, open a ketchup packet, or even hold a guitar pic, so my needs are kind of unique. 
 I had one of my studios on marketplace for quite awhile, mostly just to see what trade offers I could get... a month or two ago I got an offer on a 1991 Ibanez 540sfm, did a little research, and decided to pull the trigg
